_provenance:
Pre-refactor capture of the EVENT_NARRATION table path, taken by importing src/ui/util.js's real describeFor()/narrationVariants() builders directly — no audit page, no render core. src/ui/util.js has a comment-only diff since ab98e04, so these are the ab98e04 builders. This is a PERMANENT REGRESSION PIN on the one surface that was never broken: art-review/narration-core.js must reproduce it byte-for-byte forever. Regenerate only with a deliberate, reviewed change to the shipped table wording.

RE-PINNED 2026-07-29 (F5 + F10, .planning/quick/20260729-playtest-bug-fixes). Four cards moved and only four: table:dock, table:dock~empty, table:dock~bought, table:dock~coins. Card count unchanged at 50. Two deliberate, reviewed wording changes, both traceable to the two-tab playtest:
  F5  — the ingredient icon moved to sit directly before the ingredient NAME instead of in front of the whole flavour phrase, on every branch that names goods. No word changed; the icon-stripped text of every neutral line is byte-identical to its pre-change self, and scripts/narration_test.js pins that against hardcoded pre-change literals.
  F10 — the ADDRESSED bought/coins/empty lines had been cut down to drop their place-and-goods clause, which left "but buy it anyway" with a dangling pronoun. Restored by person-shifting each branch’s own neutral sibling, per D-46’s letter (“Only the ing (heads) branch loses its place clause”). No new phrasing was invented. table:dock~empty’s NEUTRAL text did NOT move — only its addressed variants — because the neutral empty line was already correct.
Wyatt’s stored approvals are untouched; the addressed-empty restoration goes beyond the two lines F10 named and is surfaced for his ruling in MORNING-PLAYTEST-BRIEF.md.

RE-PINNED 2026-07-30 (G2, .planning/quick/20260730-playtest-notes-fixes). ONE card added and only one: table:moored~homeMoved. Card count 50 -> 51. No existing card moved — every one of the original 50 is byte-identical to its previous pin, which is the check that says this was an addition and not a rewording.
  G2 — the moored builder mapped reason `home` to the "still docked" line unconditionally, while reason `dock` already split on whether the storm had shoved the ship there this turn. So a gust that pressed a ship against the TORTUGA berth read as though she had been parked there all along. Wyatt caught it in play: "Right got blown onto a (tortuga) dock in a storm, but the narration said right is still docked – instead of lucky break!". `home` now takes the identical movement split, built from the same two consts so the branches cannot drift apart.
  The added card renders NO new copy. Both of its strings — the neutral "Lucky break! The gust shoves … towards a dock" and its addressed sibling — already ship today through the `dock` reason, and both are Wyatt own approved rewrites (D-20/D-25/D-37). This is a new door onto approved copy, not new copy, and the card exists because D-21 requires the audit page to render every branch that can reach a player.
  D-28 is intact: justDocked, dock-when-unmoved and home-when-unmoved remain ONE shared string reached by three doors. Only the moved case split.

RE-PINNED 2026-07-30 (G1, .planning/quick/20260730-playtest-notes-fixes). THREE cards moved, ADDRESSED VARIANTS ONLY: table:dock~empty, table:dock~bought, table:dock~coins. Card count unchanged at 51. Every NEUTRAL line in the file, on all 51 cards, is byte-identical to its previous pin — asserted, not assumed. table:dock (the `ing` branch) did NOT move: G1 leaves that branch alone, so only three of the four dock cards changed.
  G1 — this NARROWS what yesterday F10 re-pin above widened, at Wyatt own word: "you already know that you docked at the Flour Patch — we don not need to tell you that again." The rule the addressed table now follows is that the addressed line says what happened to YOU, not where you are; the actor read the place name on the Dock button and again on the flip prompt before either line rendered.
  F10 defect is still fixed, by a different means. F10 gave `bought` dangling "it" an antecedent by restoring the whole place-and-goods clause; the pronoun was the real defect and the place was never the fix. The addressed `bought` line now NAMES ITS GOODS in place of the pronoun — antecedent supplied, place dropped, "it" gone from the sentence entirely. `empty` returns to its shorter pre-F10 form at his explicit ask; `coins` needs neither place nor goods.
  The NEUTRAL `g` table is deliberately untouched. A spectator watching someone else turn has no other source for either the place or the goods, so all four third-person lines keep both — which is why scripts/narration_test.js DAIRY_NEUTRAL_BEFORE literals are unchanged in this commit.
  D-16 is preserved and pinned on both sides: every branch that names its ingredient still carries that ingredient icon (49 renderings), and the 7 addressed `coins` renderings, which now name no ingredient, carry no orphaned icon either. No pattern was widened; the one cell that can no longer carry an icon is enumerated by name in the gate and paired with a positive assertion of its absence.
